title: Calling all proposals for PHPBenelux Conference 2018
content:
PHPBenelux Conference is an annual PHP oriented conference in Antwerp, Belgium and will take place on January 26 & 27 2018. We offer two days of stellar tutorials and talks, epic social events and a lineup of the best local and international businesses involved with PHP.

We like to invite speakers to submit their tutorials and talks at . Speakers have until Monday, October 2, 2017 to submit their proposals.PHPBenelux CfP

Follow us on or like us on to stay updated with news from the PHPBenelux crew.TwitterFacebook
